verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bolna lets founders choose among third-party voices/accents/styles (bolna-docs-8) and integrates providers like ElevenLabs (bolna-docs-6), but there is no mention of a voice-cloning feature for a custom brand voice, nor any documented consent process for cloning. Missing for 10: voice cloning capability, consent/verification workflow documentation, any policy on brand voice usage.
